key_insight: MyGO solves catastrophic forgetting across an externally-supplied task sequence; anima §29 PTD's blocker is insufficient unique content (sub-CDS by data-processing inequality bound). These are disjoint problems. The §7-PASS variant of MyGO-on-PTD (self-source) inherits §29's verdict; the variant where MyGO would help (external task sequence with non-derivative distributions) fails §7① by construction. No §7-PASS-and-helpful corner exists.

B-S155-4 MYGO-DOES-NOT-DPI-EVADE — DPI(C_MyGO) = DPI(C_§29) for any MyGO schedule applied to §29 PTD; MyGO's mechanism preserves §29's closed-form bound exactly (key load-bearing proposition)
